authoringStatement.statement: This ledger distinguishes checked-in project policy, inherited green contracts, external descriptive sources, and pre-production numerical choices. It does not upgrade any item to expert-reviewed authority.

authorities.title: V0 package and architecture contract
authorities.covers: layer boundary, pure operation, version identities, result/refusal shapes, no fallback, local-only scope

authorities.title: F1 domain voicing and bass-policy laws
authorities.covers: families, counts, range, generated/external/none, slash constraints, rootless external, Manual/Frozen exactness

authorities.title: T1 exact realization, degree-role, spelling, and altered-ID laws
authorities.covers: 37 seeds, exact degree tokens, required/optional/guide roles, spellings, four distinct altered realizations, slash separation

authorities.title: Drop-2 structural definition

sources.title: A Practice Method for Drop 2 Voicing
sources.claim: Drop-2 relocates the second-highest member of a close-position voicing down one octave.

authorities.covers: second-highest source ordinal and exact one-octave transform; project-specific counts/range/caps remain local policy

authorities.title: Versioned voicing-family templates and register policies

sources.title: Jazz Voicings
sources.claim: Jazz voicings commonly center guide tones, may omit the fifth, place extensions above, and use wider lower spacing.

authorities.covers: compact adaptive/fixed/context selection authority, exact selected-degree register weave, exact fixed sequences, family spans, context-gated rows, omissions and doublings

authorities.title: Low-register spacing and register numeric policy

sources.title: Jazz Voicings
sources.claim: Lower-register voicings require wider spacing to avoid muddiness; the source does not prescribe this project's numeric bands.

authorities.covers: inclusive MIDI bands 0..35/36..47/48..59/60..127 and exact 10/7/4/1 minimum gaps

authorities.title: Deterministic V0 work, memory, payload, and identifier limits
authorities.covers: 24 counters, exact/+1 outcomes, raw 96/97, retention 24/25, nine tracked-record populations, candidate-owned bounded diagnostics plus one operation-local constraint-observation accumulator, 1..256-code-point and 512-byte identifier bounds, no wall-time cutoff

authorities.title: Independent-fixture and mutation discipline
authorities.covers: no production oracle, reciprocal trace links, positive/near-miss/transposition/mutation proofs, frozen output and no clocks
